neighbours.label: Dense / positional layer-0 unit: 'And' at the start of a passage and ' not' right after a sentence-initial 'And' (And not just ...); low amplitude
fire: He kept working. And not for the money, but for the pride of it.
The town survived the flood. And not by luck alone, either.
We waited for news. And not a single call came that night.
She trusted him. And not without good reason, as it turned out.
The road was closed. And not only for the weekend, but for a month.
They won the match. And not narrowly: the score was six to nil.
I read the letter twice. And not once did he mention the debt.
Prices kept climbing. And not just for food, but for fuel too.
quiet: He kept working, but not for the money, only for the pride of it.
The town survived the flood, though not by luck alone.
We waited for news, yet no single call came that night.
She trusted him, which was not without good reason.
The road was closed, not only for the weekend but for a month.
They won the match, though the score was not close at all.
I read the letter twice, but he did not mention the debt.
Prices kept climbing, and food was not the only problem.

predictions: ' not' after a sentence-initial 'And' reaches about 0.3; ' not' after other words and 'and' mid-sentence stay under 0.1. Max is tiny (1.95) and peaks cluster at window position 0, so a pass is unlikely.
